title: Coupon Codes
subtitle: Discount codes buyers enter at checkout
valueHintFixed: Amount taken off the order subtotal. Never more than the subtotal itself.
codeHint: Letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore. Not case sensitive — LATN20 and latn20 are the same code.
codeInvalid: Use 3–50 characters: letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore.
percentRange: A percentage discount must be between 1 and 100.
hint: A coupon that has been redeemed cannot be deleted, because orders record which coupon they used. Deactivate it instead — checkout rejects inactive codes immediately.
